description: This test verifies that the search functionality on the Connectors page correctly filters the displayed connectors based on the search term entered by the user.
steps: Locate the search input field using the stable selector '[data-testid="Connector-search-box"]'.
Type a valid connector name into the search input field.
Verify that the search results update dynamically to match the search term.
Type a partial connector name into the search input field.
Verify that the search results include all connectors matching the partial term.
Type a connector name that does not exist into the search input field.
Verify that no results are displayed.
Click the 'First' button using the stable selector '[data-testid="paginator-first-page-button"]' to ensure pagination works with filtered results.
expected_results: Search results dynamically update based on the inputted search term.
Results include partial matches when a partial term is entered.
No connectors are displayed when an invalid name is searched.
Pagination functionality works correctly with filtered results.
edge_cases: Entering special characters or numbers in the search box.
Searching with leading or trailing spaces.
Searching while the page is loading.
Clearing the search input without clicking outside of it.
Searching with a term that matches multiple connectors across different pages.
data_requirements: A list of predefined connectors with unique names.
At least one connector name containing special characters.
At least one connector name with numbers.
A connector dataset larger than one page of results.
A connector name that partially matches other connectors.
dependencies: Connectors must already exist in the system.
The search functionality must be implemented and active.
The pagination system must be preconfigured and functional.
api_interactions: POST /search-logs to log the user's search activity.
performance_metrics: Time taken for search results to update after input.
Latency of API calls for fetching filtered results.
Accuracy of displayed results compared to the search term.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the search input field has ARIA attributes for accessibility.
Verify that the search results are readable by screen readers.
Check color contrast between search results and background.
